speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, can you describe the appearance of the rash on your palms and tell me how long you have had these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Do you have any history of diabetes or other systemic illnesses, and have you noticed any swelling or redness in your hands along with the numbness?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of hypopigmented macules on the elbows, combined with eyebrow thinning and loss of eyelashes, is highly suggestive of a specific parasitic infection. To confirm this suspicion, I need to examine the skin closely; REQUEST IMAGES

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Works as a farmer, no history of travel outside the local area.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of sensory loss in the palms, hypopigmented macules, and madarosis (loss of eyebrows/eyelashes) strongly points to leprosy, specifically the tuberculoid or borderline forms. I will request a skin smear and biopsy to confirm the presence of acid-fast bacilli. REQUEST TEST: Skin_Biopsy
